purpose: Freeze contemporaneous expectation context; sell-side research is validation only, not discovery.

cases.name: 宝钢股份

source.claim: Q1 net profit +2.5% was above CICC expectation of a YoY decline; price RMB8.79, target RMB11; 2015E/2016E net profit RMB7.214/8.165bn and PE 20.1x/17.7x, PB 1.2x/1.2x.

cases.rationale: The market already expected 2015 profit recovery, but the Q1 result beat the contemporaneous analyst baseline and the stock materially lagged CSI300 across 20/60/120d.

source.claim: Industrial 4.0 index had risen about 80.95% since Mar-10 versus about 48% for the broad market, and the theme was widely described as a major H2 investment narrative.
